what: The Lisp tree's layout, relative to lisp/ in the runtime root (this checkout or an installed share/romacs). GNU's files keep GNU's paths; `directories` are Romacs's own subsystems, which follow GNU's directories on the load-path in this order (crates/romacs-vm-gui/src/startup.rs runtime_load_path); each directory in `packages` is a bundled package, after them; `off_path` is on no load-path (the VM's Lisp halves, compile-time inputs). The autoloads library scans Romacs's runtime files (its subsystem directories, `romacs-*` files elsewhere on the load-path, and `files`) and each package with GNU's autoload scraper, and defines what it finds as it loads, after loadup (every other file's autoloads are in the loaddefs files tools/lisp-loaddefs makes); --loadup loads it into its world, before the user's init.
